title: Proper flat morphisms with fibrewise constant functions
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper, flat morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base] of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Assume that for every point $s\in S$, with residue field $\kappa(s)$, the canonical map $\kappa(s)\to H^0(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$ on the fibre $X_s$ is an isomorphism. Then $f_*\mathcal O_X\cong\mathcal O_S$, and this isomorphism remains true after every base change $T\to S$ [def-pc-base-change].

proof.text: For every point $s\in S$, apply [lem-sc-proper-flat-structure-sheaf-stalk] to the assumed isomorphism $\kappa(s)\to H^0(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$. This makes the specified tensor-pullback adjunction unit bijective on its stalk at $s$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-iso-on-stalks] to obtain the first conclusion.

For $g:T\to S$ and $t\in T$, the fibre of $X\times_S T\to T$ at $t$ is the base change of $X_{g(t)}$ along $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(g(t))$. Mathlib isPullback_fiberToSpecResidueField_of_isPullback gives this cartesian square. The map of spectra is flat because every module over a field is flat. Properness makes $X_{g(t)}$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-global-sections-qcqs] on the top opens. The square of global sections is a pushout; its original structure map is an isomorphism by the hypothesis, so its base-changed structure map is an isomorphism by IsPushout.isIso_inr_of_isIso. The Lean private helper proves this step.

Properness, flatness and local finite presentation persist under base change. Apply [lem-sc-proper-flat-structure-sheaf-stalk] to the projection $X\times_S T\to T$ at each $t$, using the fibre isomorphism from the previous step. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-iso-on-stalks] again to obtain the claimed isomorphism of the actual chosen adjunction unit for every $g$. Empty bases are covered by the same stalk detection theorem.
